title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Aquann Castle (Cave)
description:
The background seen in various sections of Aquann Castle and also seen in one of the final levels of the game.

MASSIVE UPDATE: Optimized GFX files, better map 16 organization, saner palette organization and now includes an extra variant.

Includes two palettes.

Due to the purple variant using much more colors, they use different map 16 files and palette.

Aquann Castle: palette rows 0 and 3.
Aquann Tower: palette rows 3 and 5.

Bundled with this submission is two parallaxing codes, meant to be inserted with UberASM Tool 2.1. Pick the one you need the most.

Please check the readme included to know what's the difference between these two uberasm files.

A good fit for cave levels.
